name: acm
description: ACM reference toolchain: component discovery (search, component, capabilities), validate, canonicalize, compile, agent-view, coverage, drift.

globalOptions.description: machine output: exactly one typed envelope on stdout, diagnostics on stderr
detail level for list views (defaults: search results compact, component list brief, single-item views full)
token-frugal rendering: Agent View projection for component detail, one line per entry for list and search views
target project whose Manifest Corpus is assembled (default: current directory)
explicit manifest file added to the corpus; a failing explicit path is fatal (ACM-D-BAD-MANIFEST)

commands.name: search
commands.description: Find components across the discovered Manifest Corpus with free-text queries: ranked matches on names, Identity Facets, and controlled semantic terms above prose mentions, with typo-tolerant fuzzy matching.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: free-text need, e.g. a component name, tag, or capability description

options.description: restrict results to one domain (v1 corpus contains only components)
maximum number of results; the total match count is always reported

commands.name: component
commands.description: Print one component's full spec verbatim from its Manifest (given a name), or list every component in the corpus (given none).

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: component name; omit to list the whole corpus

options.description: scope name resolution to one source package (cross-package disambiguator)
scope name resolution by module Identity Facet (intra-package disambiguator; combinable with --from)

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Describe the CLI itself: every command with arguments, options, machine-output support, response types, error codes, and examples — derived from the command registry.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a Manifest (Canonical JSON) or Authoring Input (YAML) against the schema, structural limits, and semantic rules.

options.description: render diagnostics as JSON on stderr (no envelope; legacy flag)

commands.name: canonicalize
commands.description: Rewrite a Manifest into Canonical JSON, or verify it is already canonical.

options.description: verify canonical form without writing; drift exits 3

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile Authoring Input (YAML) to Canonical JSON on stdout.

options.description: render diagnostics as JSON on stderr (no envelope; legacy flag)

commands.name: agent-view
commands.description: Emit the one-way Agent View (YAML) projection of a canonical Manifest.

options.description: render diagnostics as JSON on stderr (no envelope; legacy flag)

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Compute the witness coverage matrix across the four Paradigm Classes; gaps exit 4.

options.description: render the coverage matrix as JSON on stdout (legacy flag)

commands.name: drift
commands.description: Check that generated artifacts are fresh; regenerate them with --write.

options.description: regenerate stale generated artifacts in place

commands.name: agent-docs
commands.description: Generate the Discovery Skill and its context-file variants from the capability manifest (steering layer, ADR 0004): corpus-agnostic, deterministic, byte-reproducible for a given toolchain version.

options.description: print one generated target to stdout instead of checking freshness
regenerate the discovery-skill generated artifacts in place

errorCodes.description: no ACM Manifests were discovered in the assembled corpus
the requested name matches no component in the corpus
the requested name matches more than one component; qualify with --from (and --module for intra-package duplicates)
an explicitly provided manifest path failed admission (missing, unparseable, invalid, or over the structural limits)
invalid invocation: unknown command or option, unsupported enum value, or malformed number
unclassified failure; no more specific code applies
